test_meta_output_name: test the meta.output_name() method to retrieve the output column name from a polars expression
test_meta_root_names: test the meta.root_names() method to retrieve root column names from a polars expression
test_meta_undo_aliases: test the meta.undo_aliases() method to strip aliasing from a polars expression and recover the original column reference
test_meta_is_column: test the meta.is_column() method to determine if a polars expression is a plain column reference
test_meta_is_column_selection: test the meta.is_column_selection() method to check if a polars expression is a column selection with optional aliasing
